$note: Lane-consumption copy of the Orion N5 appearance. The brand layer packages/ds-tokens/src/brands/orion.tokens.json is the authority for the palette; this copy exists for engines whose theme path does not load brand overlays (GPUI, Godot). Unity consumes the generated .fsds-brand-orion scope and should not need this file.

style.fontNote: No bundled condensed grotesque font: use the engine's default UI face with heavy weights, uppercase micro-labels and letter-spacing.
